messages:
maya: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel-selection rollout I'm seeing a persistent tail bump on dedicated-west-2-pool-3. Token-level breakdown shows a jump in kernel_ms and kv_read_ms starting ~01:12 UTC.

jon: link? where can I look quickly?

maya: Grafana -> /d/redwood/perf -> pool: dedicated-west-2-pool-3. Query I'm eyeballing:
```
sum(rate(token_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le,route,pool)
```
Look at buckets > 50ms.

lee: recent batcher change increased max_batch_tokens from 1024 -> 2048 in the same deploy, could cause larger batches + more KV thrash. Config snippet from helm: 
```yaml
batcher:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  prefer_latency: false
```

arjun: I ran a quick perf profile on an affected shard — flamegraph shows kernels spending more time in matmul + memcpy around the 2nd token of long requests. Also see increased L2 miss rate on GPU; smells like different kernel path selected for that model sequence-length profile.

maya: quick numbers: baseline p50/p95/p99 token latency for route /chat/generate was 11/42/120 ms, now it's 13/68/190 ms. Token breakdown (approx): kernel_ms 40% -> 56%, kv_read_ms 20% -> 28%, serialize_ms unchanged.

sophie-pm: How many customers hit that pool? Any SLA exposure if p99 stays at ~190ms?

maya: ~6 active dedicated tenants on that pool (high qps routes). If this persists, could violate our latency SLO for 2 tenants.

ops-bot: alert: pool_headroom_low(dedicated-west-2-pool-3) fired 3x in last 10m — headroom now at 12%.

jon: we should add a per-route headroom panel and noisy-neighbor score. Proposal: noisy_neighbor_score = stddev(gpu_utilization) / avg(gpu_utilization) over 10m per pool; surface top contributors by route tag.

lee: agree. Also recommend adding request.route tag to kernel selection metrics and token histograms. Quick grafana query for per-route headroom gauge: 
```
max(pool_capacity_tokens) - sum(pool_live_allocated_tokens) by (pool,route)
```

arjun: I'll spin eBPF sampling on one host in pool-3 and run microbench kernels to see if the fp16 path is doing extra transposes. maya, can you add a per-token histogram with the new buckets (5,10,25,50,100,200,500 ms) and break out by route?

maya: on it — will patch dashboard, add per-route histogram + headroom panel, and file a follow-up runbook step to rollback batcher max_batch_tokens if noisy-neighbor score > 0.25. Assign owners: arjun kernel profiling, lee instrumentation changes, maya dashboard + runbook. I'll post updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:

jon: thanks — once dashboards are in, let's schedule a 30m sync to decide rollback or kernel-tune.

maya: target ETA 2h for dashboard + 3h for initial profiling results.

maya: tagging next actions in ticket INFRA-1127 and will link back here when done.
